AWS and Google users also report issues Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu Key Points A Microsoft outage on Thursday affected users of services like Outlook, Teams and 365. In this article AMZN MSFT GOOGL Follow your favorite stocks CREATE FREE ACCOUNT A sign on the Microsoft campus in Redmond, Washington, US, Oct. 26, 2026. David Ryder | Reuters Microsoft suffered a widespread outage on Thursday that impacted thousands of users in North America, according to outage-tracking website Downdetector.com . The outage began shortly before 1 p.m. and affected services like Outlook, Teams and 365. Amazon Web Services and Google users also reported outages on the site. "We've determined a portion of infrastructure is experiencing elevated load across multiple regions, which is likely contributing to the connectivity errors," the company's Microsoft 365 Status account wrote in a post to social media platform X shortly after 1:30 p.m. ET. The company determined that the outage was caused by an increase in unavailable servers and launched a restart of impacted servers. The shutdown may be linked to failed health checks caused by a "specific component that's responsible for processing server health," Microsoft added . "We've taken steps to prevent additional servers from being impacted while we work to return the affected servers to service," Microsoft added.
